name: Beau Bayh
summary:
Birch Evans "Beau" Bayh IV ( BY; born November 8, 1995) is an American attorney and politician who is the Secretary of State–elect of Indiana. A member of the Democratic Party, he is the son of former Indiana governor and senator Evan Bayh, and grandson of former senator Birch Bayh.
Bayh was elected Indiana Secretary of State in 2026, defeating Republican nominee Max Engling with 51.8% of the vote.
